ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There is a circle in the figure, point X is near the center inside the circle, and two straight lines intersect at X. Among them, Z, X, W are on the same straight line, and Y, X, V are on the same straight line. The requested ∠ZXV is the upper angle, labeled in the figure as (2x+65)°; its vertical angle ∠YXW is below, labeled in the figure as (4x+15)°. Reasoning: Because ∠ZXV and ∠YXW are vertical angles, they are equal. Set up the equation: 2x+65=4x+15. Solving gives 50=2x, so x=25. Substitute into the expression for ∠ZXV: 2(25)+65=50+65=115. Therefore m∠ZXV=115°.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as two straight lines/diameters intersecting at point X: Z-X-W are collinear and Y-X-V are collinear. The angle asked for, ∠ZXV, is the upper angle labeled (2x+65)°, and its vertical opposite angle ∠YXW is labeled (4x+15)°. Use the vertical angles theorem to set these expressions equal: 2x+65 = 4x+15. Solve for x, then substitute back into 2x+65 to get m∠ZXV = 115°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有一个圆，点 X 在圆内中心附近，两条直线在 X 相交。其中 Z、X、W 在同一直线上，Y、X、V 在同一直线上。所求的 ∠ZXV 是上方角，图中标为 (2x+65)°；它的对顶角 ∠YXW 在下方，图中标为 (4x+15)°。

推理：因为 ∠ZXV 和 ∠YXW 是对顶角，所以它们相等。列方程：2x+65=4x+15。解得 50=2x，所以 x=25。代入 ∠ZXV 的表达式：2(25)+65=50+65=115。因此 m∠ZXV=115°。
